task.title: Option 1: Create a custom button with a launch script (For Salesforce classic Users)

step.cmd: Go to Setup > Create > Object > Buttons, Links, and Actions. (for standard objects, go to Customize > Object > Buttons Links, and Actions)
Enter the Label. Name is auto-populated.
Enter the Description of the button to help users understand the button.
Select a Display Type for the button.

entry.p: To display the custom button as a link
To display the custom button as a detail button. For example, to display the custom button with Edit, Delete, Cancel, and Clone buttons.
To display the custom button as a list button. For example, to display the custom button with Merge Contacts, New, Add to Categories and so on.

Change the following in the above code to refer to your app and action flow:

li.p: parentId – id of the context object or related parent object where the button is placed.
hostURL– top domain name of the Salesforce URL
appId– App's unique id taken from any app record.
actionflowName– (Optional) Name of the action flow to execute when the App launches.

note.p: We recommend the use of a named action flow (actionflowName) when the same app with all its mappings needs to be launched from different object records. This prevents the need to clone copies of the same app and helps in better maintainability.

step.cmd: Click Check Syntax to verify that no errors have been made in the script.
